evidence.ACL: Interstitial hyperintensity signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: Grade 1 injury of MCL and mild MCL bursitis
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage and subchondral bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with osteophytes formation of left knee, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: Loculated fluid collection between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst
